description: The escape hatch — a bare polymorphic element with no visual opinion. Exists so a consumer has something to attach a custom property or a one-off style to without reaching for a raw <div>.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the single child element instead of a wrapping <div>, merging the
box class onto it — e.g. `<Box asChild><section>...</section></Box>`.
